trivialXH — XH module

Source: R/human-XH-trivial.R
trivialXH.Rd

The trivial module sets up two forcing functions:

  1. a forcing function to output net infectiousness, \(\kappa\)

  2. a forcing function to output human population density, \(H\)

Basic setup uses a function if it is passed. If no function is passed, the functions are built from function objects (see ramp.func::F_obj) using make_function, which returns a function of the form \(F(t,V).\)

The variables passed to the functions, \(V\), are returned by get_variables, which dispatches on the class of the stored function object (by default, an empty list).

Net Infectiousness

The forcing functions are set up as composed time series functions with four separate composable elements: $$F_\kappa(t) = \kappa \times S(t, V_s) \times T(t, V_t) \times K(t, V_k)$$ where

  • \(\kappa\) or kappa is the mean net infectiousness

  • \(S(t,V_s)\) or F_season is a seasonal pattern function

  • \(T(t,V_t)\) or F_trend is a trend pattern function

  • \(K(t,V_k)\) or F_shock is a perturbation function

Human Population Density

The forcing functions are set up as composed time series functions with four separate composable elements: $$F_H(t) = H \times S(t, V_s) \times T(t, V_t) \times K(t, V_k)$$ where

  • \(H\) or H is the mean human population density

  • \(S(t,V_s)\) or H_season is a seasonal pattern function

  • \(T(t,V_t)\) or H_trend is a trend pattern function

  • \(K(t,V_k)\) or H_shock is a perturbation function

Seasonal Pattern

Note: \(0 \leq F_\kappa(t) \leq 1\)

Parameters

Net Infectiousness

kappa

mean net infectiousness

F_season

a seasonal pattern function, \({S(t,V_s)}\)

F_trend

a trend function, \(T(t,V_t)\)

F_shock

a shock function, \(K(t,V_k)\)

season_par

dispatches get_variables to get \(V_s\)

trend_par

dispatches get_variables to get \(V_t\)

shock_par

dispatches get_variables to get \(V_k\)

Human Population Density

H

human population density

H_season

a seasonal pattern function, \({S(t,V_s)}\)

H_trend

a trend function, \(T(t,V_t)\)

H_shock

a shock function, \(K(t,V_k)\)

H_season_par

dispatches get_variables to get \(V_s\)

H_trend_par

dispatches get_variables to get \(V_t\)

H_shock_par

dispatches get_variables to get \(V_k\)

Setup also adds the objects season_par and trend_par and shock_par for use by ramp.func

Get and Change

  • get_XH_pars — the trivialXH method returns all the parameters

  • change_XH_pars — change parameters by name

Notes

  1. The module has no state variables.

  2. The size of an object saved by saveRDS balloons if it saves a function, so the saveXDS function strips the functions and readXDS remakes the function from the stored function object using make_function.

  3. F_season, F_trend, F_shock, H_season, H_trend, and H_shock can be set up manually by passing any user-defined function. If so, the user should use saveRDS and readRDS rather than saveXDS and readXDS.

  4. Setup uses a residence vector. The module constructs H and kappa with length nStrata[i].
